assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied portrait meadow backdrop. Create a finished children's storybook background for a cozy prayer companion game by adding ONLY a natural walking trail to the lower half of this meadow. Preserve the existing sky, clouds, distant hills, palette, painterly gouache texture, sunlight and framing. Keep portrait 2:3 composition.
Path composition: an inviting warm sandy-earth path starts broadly at the bottom edge, centered around 50% of canvas width and spanning roughly 32% of canvas width. It gently curves LEFT to around x=44% at y=74%, then gently RIGHT to x=57% at y=60%, and ends narrow around x=54% at y=51% where a separate gateway will be placed. This is one subtle smooth bend, not a tight zigzag. It tapers continuously in perspective, from broad foreground to a narrow distant end. The path is visibly grounded in the meadow, with irregular softly painted grassy borders, small tufts along edges, warm cream and ochre soil variation, subtle dappled sunlight and a few tiny embedded pebbles. Include only three or four irregular FLAT stepping slabs embedded flush in the earth, smaller toward distance, low contrast warm sandstone, no outlines. Leave ample continuous earth for walking. No floating round discs, no repeated oval buttons, no raised platforms, no thick outlines, no UI markers or glow. Cheerful, handcrafted, softly cartoonish; clean readable at phone size. No new trees, props, characters, gateway, flowers, text or UI. Output a complete opaque backdrop.

One entire small rounded oak tree prop, including trunk base, friendly cloud-like sage foliage and warm brown trunk. Slight three-quarter elevated view, squat toy proportions. Fill central 80% of square with padding around crown and ground contact. No soil island, no surrounding scenery or ground shadow. Genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or solid color.

One low asymmetrical clump of rounded sage-green meadow bushes with a few larger leaves. Full shrub silhouette visible with small clear padding. Soft storybook painted volume, neutral three-quarter elevated view, fits beside a walking path. No flowers, no soil island, no scenery, no ground shadow. Square asset with genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or solid color.

One small charming patch of three cream daisies with honey-yellow centers and sage-green leaves, varied heights, growing together. Full stems and leaf tips visible. Neutral three-quarter view, square centered asset occupying 75% of canvas, generous transparent padding. No soil island, vase, scenery or ground shadow. Genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or solid color.

One tiny friendly cartoon robin standing in three-quarter profile facing LEFT, warm cinnamon chest, tan-brown wings, two tiny feet, one visible round dark eye with a small highlight, calm curious expression, closed beak. Squat rounded storybook proportions. Whole bird visible with clear padding around tail, head and feet. No clothes, accessories, perch, ground shadow or scenery. Square centered asset with genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or solid color.

One small squat glowing paper lantern prop, round cream-gold paper body with simple subtle vertical ribs, warm amber wooden top and flat base, short friendly handle. Standing upright, slight elevated three-quarter view. Warm light contained INSIDE the paper silhouette; no external glow or shadow. Square asset full object visible with padding. No flame visible, text, symbols, floating particles, ground or scenery. Genuinely transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or solid color.

One small welcoming garden arch made from two rounded warm wood posts and a gently curved wooden top, with a few sage-green leaves and three cream daisies tucked at the top. Empty OPEN center must be transparent. No doors, fences, writing, ribbons, hanging objects, ground or shadow. Entire arch feet and leafy top visible, centered square sprite with padding. Slight elevated three-quarter view, soft painted cartoon style. Genuinely transparent alpha around and within the arch, not a checkerboard or solid color.

processing: Size-only exports with alpha preserved. Backdrop: 768x1152 JPEG quality 88. Tree and gateway: 768x768 PNG. Other sprites: 512x512 PNG. Original generated PNGs retained in review outputs.
